issue_request: FHIR-13504 was Published/Not Persuasive with Modification for STU3. It asked for AuditEvent support for recording OperationOutcome evidence; the accepted resolution used AuditEvent.entity, likely with a contained OperationOutcome, reference, description, and example instead of adding a new operationOutcome element.
